versions.subject: Merge PR #4919 from @MATTANDERS0N - Added new detections related BOINC
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\conhost.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'CONHOST.EXE'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '--headless'
        - 'powershell'
condition: all of selection_*
